# Code of conduct

toil adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/)
as its code of conduct. Read it there: it's short, and it is the whole of the
standard everyone here is held to, maintainers included.

In brief: be kind and honest, assume good faith, credit other people's work, and
keep criticism on the work rather than the person. Harassment, discrimination,
personal attacks and sharing someone's private information are not tolerated.

## Where it applies

Every space this project runs: issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, the
feedback page, and anywhere someone speaks on the project's behalf. It applies to
automated participants too: the review and triage agents are held to the same
standard, and a person who points one at someone else answers for what it says.

## Reporting

If someone's conduct here worries you, contact Imagile through
[imagile.dev/contact](https://www.imagile.dev/contact) and say that it's about toil.
For a single comment, GitHub's **Report content** menu on that comment reaches
GitHub's own moderators as well. Reports are handled in confidence, and the person
reporting is never named to the person reported without their agreement.

The maintainers decide what happens next using the Covenant's enforcement ladder:
a warning, a temporary limit on activity, a temporary suspension, or a permanent
ban.
